cards.name: Seize the Storm
cards.oracleText:
Create a red Elemental creature token with trample and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard plus the number of cards with flashback you own in exile."
Flashback {6}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Seize the Secrets
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast if you've committed a crime this turn. (Targeting opponents, anything they control, and/or cards in their graveyards is a crime.)
Draw two cards.

cards.name: Seize the Spoils
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards and create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

cards.name: Seizures
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature becomes tapped, this Aura deals 3 damage to that creature's controller unless that player pays {3}.

cards.name: Seize the Soul
cards.oracleText:
Destroy target nonwhite, nonblack creature. Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Haunt (When this spell card is put into a graveyard after resolving, exile it haunting target creature.)
When the creature this card haunts dies, destroy target nonwhite, nonblack creature. Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Seize the Day
cards.oracleText:
Untap target creature. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
Flashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Seize the Spotlight
cards.oracleText: Each opponent chooses fame or fortune. For each player who chose fame, gain control of a creature that player controls until end of turn. Untap those creatures and they gain haste until end of turn. For each player who chose fortune, you draw a card and create a Treasure token.

cards.name: Seize Opportunity
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
• Up to two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player loses 2 life and draws two cards.
